name: MA Alignment
description: Stocks where short-term EMA crosses above long-term EMA
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 20 day ema and 20 day ema > 50 day ema and 50 day ema > 200 day ema ))

name: RSI Divergence
description: Stocks making higher highs while price makes lower highs
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 1 day ago close and 14 day rsi < 1 day ago 14 day rsi and latest close > 100 ))

name: Bollinger Squeeze
scan: ({cash} ( 20 day bollinger upper - 20 day bollinger lower < 20 day bollinger upper * 0.02 ))

name: Volume Spike
scan: ({cash} ( latest volume > 20 day sma volume * 3 and latest close > 1 day ago close ))

name: Morning Star
scan: ({cash} ( 2 day ago close > 2 day ago open and latest close < 2 day ago close * 0.98 and latest close > 1 day ago close * 1.01 ))

name: Doji Engulfing
scan: ({cash} ( 1 day ago close < 1 day ago open and latest close > latest open and (latest high - latest low) < (1 day ago high - 1 day ago low) * 0.5 ))

name: EMA Crossover
scan: ({cash} ( latest 9 day ema > 21 day ema and 1 day ago 9 day ema <= 21 day ema ))

name: MACD Bullish
scan: ({cash} ( 12 26 9 day macd > 0 and 1 day ago 12 26 9 day macd <= 0 ))

name: Price Channel Breakout
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(20, High) and 1 day ago close <= Max(20, High) ))

name: Low Float Stocks
description: Small price range stocks with high volume
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 2 and latest close < 20 and latest volume > 100000 and Max(52, High) - Min(52, Low) < latest close * 0.5 ))

name: Fibonacci Retracement
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.382 and latest close < Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.5 ))

name: Fibonacci Buy Zone
description: Stocks above 61.8% fib retracement with strong close
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Min(5, Low) + (Max(5, High) - Min(5, Low)) * 0.618 and latest close > Max(5, High) ))

name: Fibonacci Sell Zone
scan: ({cash} ( daily close > ( 1 day ago high + 1 day ago low + 1 day ago close ) / 3 + ( 0.5 * ( 1 day ago high - 1 day ago low ) ) and 1 day ago close <= ( 1 day ago high + 1 day ago low + 1 day ago close ) / 3 + ( 0.5 * ( 1 day ago high - 1 day ago low ) ) and daily close > ( 1 day ago high + 1 day ago low + 1 day ago close ) / 3 + ( 0.382 * ( 1 day ago high - 1 day ago low ) ) and 1 day ago close <= ( 1 day ago high + 1 day ago low + 1 day ago close ) / 3 + ( 0.382 * ( 1 day ago high - 1 day ago low ) ) ))

name: Fibonacci Rally
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(50, High) * 0.5 and latest close < Max(50, High) * 0.7 and latest volume > 100000 ))

name: Fibonacci Breakout
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(50, High) * 0.5 and latest close > Min(50, Low) * 1.5 ))

name: Strong Fibonacci
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(250, High) * 0.5 and latest close > 50 and latest volume > 100000 ))

name: Fibonacci Levels
scan: ({cash} ( latest close >= Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.382 and latest close <= Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.618 ))

name: Positive Fibonacci
scan: ( {33489} ( daily close > ( 1 day ago high - 1 day ago low ) * 0.618 + 1 day ago low and daily close > 50 and daily volume > 500000 and daily rsi( 14 ) > 60 ))

name: Fibonacci Momentum
description: Stocks in 38-50% retracement with volume confirmation
scan: ( {33489} ( daily close > Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.5 and daily close < Min(100, Low) + (Max(100, High) - Min(100, Low)) * 0.382 and daily volume > 20 day sma volume * 1.2 ))

name: Fibonacci 61.8% Buy
scan: ({cash} ( latest low > Min(55, Low) + (Max(55, High) - Min(55, Low)) * 0.618 and 1 day ago low <= Min(55, Low) + (Max(55, High) - Min(55, Low)) * 0.618 ))

name: Large Cap Stocks
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 100 and latest volume > 500000 ))

name: Green Stocks
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 200 day sma and latest close > 50 ))

name: Volatile Stocks
scan: ({cash} ( (latest high - latest low) / latest close > 0.05 and latest volume > 100000 ))

name: Active Stocks
scan: ({cash} ( latest volume > 20 day sma volume * 1.3 and latest close > 50 and latest close < 500 ))

name: Mid Cap Stocks
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > 50 and latest close < 500 and latest volume > 200000 ))

name: 52 Week High Breakout
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) and 1 day ago close <= Max(252, High) ))

name: Strong Volume
description: High volume stocks with strong price action
scan: ({cash} ( latest volume > 200000 and latest close > 1 day ago close * 1.05 ))

name: Low Price High Volume
description: Affordable stocks with high trading activity
scan: ({cash} ( latest close < 50 and latest close > 5 and latest volume > 500000 ))

name: Moving Average Rising
scan: ({cash} ( 20 day sma > 20 day ago sma and 50 day sma > 50 day ago sma and 200 day sma > 200 day ago sma ))

name: Near 52 Week High
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) * 0.95 ))

name: Fibonacci 252 High 50%
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) * 0.9 and latest volume > 100000 ))

name: Fibonacci 252 High 61.8%
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) * 0.9 and latest volume > 50000 ))

name: Fibonacci 252 High 78%
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) * 0.9 and latest volume > 50000 ))

name: Fibonacci 252 High/Low
scan: ({cash} ( latest close > Max(252, High) * 0.9 and latest volume > 50000 ))
